scenario_text: Management attributes falling profits entirely to market conditions despite evidence of internal operational failures.
Management attributes falling profits to both market conditions and documented operational failures.
A project team claims the delay was unavoidable despite repeated ignored warnings.
A project team acknowledges that ignored warnings contributed to the delay.
A hospital attributes rising readmissions solely to patient behavior despite discharge process failures.
A hospital reviews both patient factors and discharge process quality.
A software team blames users for defects despite documented testing gaps.
A software team acknowledges testing gaps as a contributing factor.
A support organization claims service quality is excellent despite rising complaint volume.
A support organization investigates complaint trends and service quality metrics.
A supply chain team insists resilience is strong despite repeated stockouts.
A supply chain team acknowledges resilience weaknesses revealed by stockouts.
A finance team claims liquidity is healthy despite relying on delayed supplier payments.
A finance team identifies supplier-payment delays as a liquidity risk.
A bridge operator describes the structure as safe despite worsening inspection findings.
A bridge operator updates risk assessments based on inspection findings.
A model developer claims reliability leadership despite increasing hallucination rates.
A model developer investigates the causes of increasing hallucination rates.
A team claims workload is sustainable despite increasing burnout indicators.
A team reviews workload assumptions after burnout indicators rise.
